summary: Re-tested the four fixes from iteration_120 plus the dark-theme contrast sweep that iteration_120 could not reach. F1, F3, F4 verified fixed via DOM. F2 is PARTIALLY fixed: the not-wired NxSection is now present with data-nx-state=NOT_CONFIGURED and the WAITING_APPROVAL token is gone, but the raw token 'VITE_XDR_RESPONSE_URL' still leaks through the xdr-approvals-error path (XdrApprovalsPage.jsx:49). Dark-theme sweep found (a) active nav / theme-toggle amber pill fails the 3:1 threshold on every route (contrast 1.96), and (b) '⊘ RESPONSE RECORD UNREACHABLE' badge on /xdr/admin/edr-response renders with identical fg=bg (ratio 1.00 — text is invisible).

F1_investigation_workspace.detail: open-case-<id> now routes to /xdr/investigations/<caseId>/_engine?tab=story (verified with case_golden_cobalt_strike_36fae8f5). data-testid 'investigation-workspace-tabs' present. All 8 tabs (story, trajectory, process, graph, security_state, evidence, verdict, attack) render content and are visible. case-artifacts-table renders with headers ['Artifact / stage','Type','SHA-256','Decoded output','Stop reason'] and the empty state title 'No extracted artifact is recorded' shows when there are no artifacts.

F2_approvals.detail: xdr-approvals-not-wired NxSection present, NxState chip has data-nx-state=NOT_CONFIGURED. 'WAITING_APPROVAL' token is gone from body. BUT 'VITE_XDR_RESPONSE_URL' still leaks via the xdr-approvals-error banner: XdrApprovalsPage.jsx line 49 still writes 'Response Engine URL not set (VITE_XDR_RESPONSE_URL).' when listPendingApprovals throws RESPONSE_ENGINE_NOT_DEPLOYED. Same wording also present in XdrAutomationRuleEditorPage.jsx:85, XdrEvidenceRefPage.jsx:45, AnalystResponseDrawer.jsx:87 and playbook designer — full estate should be de-tokenised.

F3_evidence_explorer.detail: evidence-table ALWAYS renders with headers ['Artifact','Case / host','Decoder','SHA-256','Decoded output','Stop reason']. Old 'NO MATCHING EVIDENCE' block gone; empty-state title 'No matching evidence' surfaces from the table itself.

F4_rules_and_playbooks.detail: xdr-rules-table and xdr-playbooks-table both render when the store is empty; xdr-rules-not-wired and xdr-playbooks-not-wired NxSections co-exist. Headers non-empty. Created 1 rule -> row visible with 'Draft' lifecycle chip -> Duplicate added a 2nd row -> Delete removed both. Same lifecycle for playbook create/duplicate/delete. HOWEVER: a stray '}' text node renders under the rules table (and, by parity, the playbooks table). It comes from an orphan JSX text child on XdrAutomationRulesPage.jsx:138 and XdrPlaybooksPage.jsx:140 (a leftover ')}' from the removed short-circuit — Babel parses it as JSX text). Cosmetic only, but user-visible.

violations.note: Active nav row (Control Center / Incidents / Investigate / Automate / Administration when selected) and the DARK toggle chip have white text on amber; below 3:1 threshold. Affects every dark-mode page.
Foreground colour is identical to background — the badge text is effectively invisible in dark mode.

action_items: XdrApprovalsPage.jsx:49 — drop the '(VITE_XDR_RESPONSE_URL)' token from the error string; the NxSection above it already carries the operator meaning. Same clean-up for XdrAutomationRuleEditorPage.jsx:85, XdrEvidenceRefPage.jsx:45, AnalystResponseDrawer.jsx:87 and XdrPlaybookDesignerPage.jsx:183.
Remove the stray ')}' left-over on XdrAutomationRulesPage.jsx ~line 138 and XdrPlaybooksPage.jsx ~line 140 (renders as a visible '}' under the table).

Fix dark-mode contrast on the active primary-nav pill and the xdr-theme-toggle chip — the amber (rgb(245,158,11)) fill fails 3:1 against rgb(241,245,249) text. Either darken the text (near-black on amber gives ~7:1) or drop the amber to a darker accent.
Fix the invisible '⊘ RESPONSE RECORD UNREACHABLE' badge on /xdr/admin/edr-response — foreground and background are the same colour in dark mode.
critical_code_review_comments: Both Rules and Playbooks pages carry a real orphan JSX text child ('}') where the old short-circuit used to close; parses because JSX treats it as text, so the tests still pass, but the character is visible to the user. Worth a lint rule to catch stray ')' / '}' glyphs at JSX top level.

Machine-token error strings ('VITE_XDR_RESPONSE_URL.') are duplicated verbatim across 5 files. Centralise the operator-facing wording in one place (e.g. a helper next to responseEngineApi.RESPONSE_ENGINE_CONFIGURED) so 'do not leak build-flag names' is enforced in one edit.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login works but the preview backend is slow / sometimes rate-limited by Cloudflare — space page.goto by >=3s and re-login when document.body.innerText.length drops below ~50 chars. Selectors used: [data-testid='investigation-workspace-tabs'] (NxTabs) with per-tab child [data-testid='investigation-workspace-tabs-<key>']; content wrappers use tab-<key>-content EXCEPT security_state whose content id is 'tab-security-state-content' (dash, not underscore) — kept for parity but worth aligning with the tab key. Dark mode theme toggle does NOT set document-level data-nx-theme; it visibly changes the palette but the attribute is empty — evaluate colours via getComputedStyle rather than the html/body attribute.

rca_of_the_issue.F2_VITE_leak: The list-pending-approvals fetch throws Engine.RESPONSE_ENGINE_NOT_DEPLOYED when RESPONSE_ENGINE_CONFIGURED is false; XdrApprovalsPage catches it (line 47-52) and sets the user-visible error string to 'Response Engine URL not set (VITE_XDR_RESPONSE_URL).', which is then rendered inside data-testid='xdr-approvals-error'. The migration to the NxSection/NxState 'not-wired' block replaced the empty-state prose but left the error-branch prose untouched, so the raw build-flag name still reaches the DOM whenever the queue is polled while unconfigured.
rca_of_the_issue.F4_stray_brace: The pre-migration render was `{rows.length === 0 ? <BespokeEmpty/> : <NxDataTable ... />}`. When the ternary was removed, the closing `)}` of the JSX expression was left behind as a stray text child under the section; Babel parses it as JSX text so it does not fail compilation, but it renders as a visible '}' beneath the table.
rca_of_the_issue.dark_contrast_active_nav: The active primary-nav item uses --nx-accent (amber ~ rgb(245,158,11)) as its background with the standard --nx-text (rgb(241,245,249)) foreground. That pairing is <3:1 regardless of theme, but only becomes user-visible in dark mode where the pill dominates the sidebar.
